data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; European listing symbols

methodology.defensive_split: 24% XEON.DE EUR overnight-rate proxy + 16% SGLD.MI gold ETC
methodology.ranking: 68-session return / annualized volatility squared; positive 68-session and 12-month momentum filter; monthly rebalance
methodology.warning: Independent European UCITS approximation, not official Logical Invest. The universe is limited to mapped seed candidates and has uneven country coverage. XEON is a cash-like proxy, SGLD is an ETC (not a UCITS ETF); neither is equivalent to US Treasury/GLD. No fees, taxes, slippage or currency-hedging adjustment. Benchmark VWCE.DE is a proxy.
